import pathlib
wd=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689779/attempts/75b9ca6211d4403aafd75899a9af5d34/system/state/workspace')
prog=wd/'programs/task-26de1145.py'; prog.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    # Copy the contents of the first compartment into all matching compartments.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = 8
    rows = [i for i in range(h) if all(v == sep for v in grid[i])]
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == sep for i in range(h))]
    rseps = rows
    cseps = cols
    rbounds = [-1] + rseps + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + cseps + [w]
    rparts = [(rbounds[i]+1, rbounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(rbounds)-1)]
    cparts = [(cbounds[i]+1, cbounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(cbounds)-1)]
    # source upper-left cell block
    r0,r1 = rparts[0]; c0,c1 = cparts[0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ra, rb in rparts:
        for ca, cb in cparts:
            if (ra,rb,ca,cb) == (r0,r1,c0,c1):
                continue
            for rr in range(min(rb-ra,r1-r0)):
                for cc in range(min(cb-ca,c1-c0)):
                    if grid[r0+rr][c0+cc] != 3:
                        out[ra+rr][ca+cc] = grid[r0+rr][c0+cc]
    return out
'''
prog.write_text(code)
exec(code)
